messages:
Maya: quick question — during generator resume after auth refresh i'm seeing goroutines pile up and no error returned. repro in sampleapp
Samir: can you paste the minimal repro? which generator API are you using?
Maya: using the iterator style (Generator.Iter -> next token loop). ctx is cancelled during the handshake retry, but the loop never exits. logs: 
```
INFO auth: refresh start
WARN gen: handshake retry triggered
ERROR gen: stream read timeout
<hang> goroutine stuck in generator.next()
```
Eli: do you get any EOF or cancellation error eventually or just leak?
Maya: nothing. app needs manual kill. i added a timeout ctx and it still stuck.
Josh: @Maya can you point to the sampleapp code? i can try locally.
Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/go-gen-repro/pull/12 - main.go has the flow (short lived ctx, auth refresh simulated)
Samir: repro confirmed. Python SDK returns context.Canceled early, go impl seems to wait until runtime returns state. looks like a handshake-retry race with token-refresh backoff.
Eli: hmm parity mismatch. Go's generator keeps internal goroutine that owns the transport + KV cache and doesn't observe ctx cancel during the auth handshake. Should we make iterator.Next(ctx) take a ctx? or change internal runtime to monitor the user ctx?
Josh: changing Next signature is breaking; prefer internal fix first. maybe add a cancellation watcher goroutine that closes transport on ctx.Done().
Maya: that would help. simple watcher would have to be registered per-iterator. ack that it's internal but low cost.
Samir: i sketched a patch where iterator starts: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parentCtx)
go func() {
  select {
  case <-parentCtx.Done():
    cancel()
  case <-done: 
  }
}()
// pass ctx to handshake/retry logic
```
But need to ensure cancel propagates to underlying runtime without double-closing channels.
Eli: also consider returning a sentinel error type (ErrStreamCanceled) so callers can distinguish auth retry vs user cancel. keeps parity with other SDKs.
Maya: +1 for ErrStreamCanceled. tests in python expect context.Canceled semantics.
devex-bot: Automated test run for PR #12: 2 failing tests (gen/context_cancel_repro), 18 passed.
Josh: cool — @Samir can you open a PR draft with watcher + ErrStreamCanceled and add reproducer test? i can review.
Samir: will do. plan: add watcher, propagate ctx to handshake layer, add sentinel error, tests. assign to maya for verification.
Maya: thanks. also logging: please emit a single log line when we transition to canceled state so ops can detect leak vs slow runtime.
Eli: noted. i'll update runtime trace points.
Josh: sounds good. :thumbsup:
Maya: action items: Samir PR, Maya verify sampleapp, Eli add trace, Josh review. closing loop tomorrow.
